ambiguities.text: The specification does not define exactly how gas_price should be mapped to max_fee_per_gas and max_priority_fee_per_gas
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume both max_fee_per_gas and max_priority_fee_per_gas are set equal to the original gas_price value.

ambiguities.text: The specification says wallets 'MUST' convert but doesn't specify handling if user explicitly requests Type 1
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the conversion is automatic and transparent; wallets should not offer option to preserve Type 1 format.

ambiguities.text: The specification doesn't address what happens to the chain_id field during conversion
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume chain_id is preserved unchanged during the Type 1 to Type 2 conversion.

implicit_assumptions.description: The network supports EIP-1559 and Type 2 transactions (London fork or later)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Converted Type 2 transactions would be rejected by pre-London nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: Users submitting Type 1 transactions will accept automatic conversion to Type 2
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users expecting Type 1 behavior might be confused by Type 2 fee mechanics

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet performs the conversion correctly without modifying transaction intent
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect conversion could result in transactions with different gas economics than intended

implicit_assumptions.description: No security benefit is lost by deprecating Type 1 in favor of Type 2
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Potential edge cases where Type 1 offered security properties not present in Type 2
